summary: the M1 shadow gate is not scorable: no_observed_consumption

incomplete.message: no delivery has been observed consuming a projection, so there is no comparison set to score; this is the absence of a measurement, not a measured absence

observations.message: the baseline's median operator-intervention count is already 0, so no non-negative count can be strictly lower; as worded, this criterion cannot be cleared by any shadow set and needs an explicit decision before the comparison means anything

measurementContract.againstRubric: the baseline's operatorInterventionRubric, by the baseline's own method.scoring steps

members.name: interventionCount
members.note: operator inputs the delivery could not proceed without while the host had stopped; inputs made while the host was progressing are steering, not interventions

members.name: policyRequiredInterruptionCount
members.source: the delivery journal, cross-checked against the transcript
members.note: admission-grant prompts, the contract confirmation, takeover authorizations and sensitive approvals; recorded beside the interventions and counted into neither figure

members.name: blockedSeconds / progressingSeconds
members.note: blocked is the sum over interventions of the idle gap from the host's last event to the operator input that restarted it; all remaining window time is progressing

preconditions: The host session transcript must survive the session. A disposable host configuration directory takes the transcript with it when it is removed, and the two wall-clock figures become unrecoverable — the delivery can then never be counted, whatever the binding observed.
The delivery window's start and end must be identifiable in the transcript: the operator's scoped handoff message opens it, the merge closes it.
